claim: Acceptance-plan section 5 step 1 (read-only, execution disabled) against a signed-in IBKR paper IB Gateway: the official ibapi client probe returned status 'passed' and the NautilusTrader 2.0.0rc5 native adapter probe returned 'passed'. Partial evidence only: this is step 1 of 4; steps 2-4 need Nautilus native paper stock orders, which are blocked upstream (see blockers).
plan_history: plan.json was written before the first run and is kept verbatim, but was not independently reviewed before the run. blockers.scope: conditional: sessions where IB serves delayed data
blockers.effect: Nautilus native historical bars fail on IB notice 2188 when the session lacks real-time API data (observed 13:18Z with DELAYED data; with REALTIME granted the native bars returned)
blockers.source: rc5 Cargo.toml pins ibapi = "=3.3.0"; https://github.com/wboayue/rust-ibapi/issues/764 fixed by #765 (9d97926) in v4.0.0
blockers.unblock: a NautilusTrader release with ibapi >= 4.0.0 (open PR https://github.com/nautechsystems/nautilus_trader/pull/5041 pins =4.1.0)

blockers.effect: Nautilus native stock orders are denied locally (venue IB never matches SMART)
blockers.unblock: an upstream fix at the pinned release

limitations: Read-only step 1 only; acceptance-plan steps 2-4 (client-id ownership, bounded paper orders, reconnect/restart reconciliation) are not run.

Market-data type depends on the session: DELAYED at 13:16Z (pre-market), none during a competing session at 13:23Z (10197), REALTIME at 14:13Z; a delayed quote never satisfies a case that needs a current real-time feed.
The paper-account check comes from the ibapi probe; the Nautilus historical client has no account query of its own.
One session on one host (Windows IB Gateway 10.50 reached from WSL over mirrored networking); not a new-host acceptance.
Account ids are not recorded, not even hashed; balances are not recorded.
